# Weyland-Yutani Executive Handbook ## Corporate Liaison and Senior Management Edition
[color=#a4885c]Weyland-Yutani Corporation. EXECUTIVE. For Company employees of grade WYC5 and above. The contents of this handbook may not be disclosed to any employee below WYC5, and never to anyone outside the Company.[/color]
These are the regulations and procedures for Company executives at colonial sites. Executives are responsible for the site, its staff and the Company's position on the colony, and are expected to know every Company handbook. The Employee, Research Staff and Corporate Security handbooks are bound into this edition.
Where a situation isn't covered by any handbook, the executive is to act in the Company's interest and account for the decision afterwards. Executives are judged on results. An executive who exposes the Company is not.
[italic]Building Better Worlds.[/italic]
